x: John Regis was beaten on the dip by Colin Jackson and Todd Bennett in the 100 and Marcus was given the same treatment in the 200. But the 4x100 recorded a magnificent win in 41.26.
He became European Junior Champion in 1985 when 18, and was runner up to Colin Jackson in the World Junior Championships the following year.

The other main contenders, apart from John, were Colin Jackson and Nigel Walker. Our man used to hurdle at school and was reported before the event to have stated that once around the turn, Jackson and the rest would "just see my back".
